name: Jace The Overdrive
original_name: ジェイス・ザ・オーバードライブ
source:
The leader of the terrorist organization Full Metal Gigas, fanatics who believe becoming a cyborg is a form of transcedence.  In many ways a typical Fanatic of the Light, who will keep going forward, destroying everything that gets in his way until he reaches the future.  He is the second Godslayer.  He confesses he accidentally blew off his own penis when he over-stressed his cybernetics.  

[spoiler] Having grown up as a delinquent in Adler, he joined the military in an attempt to show up Valzeride, who beat him down once in the past.  However, as he served in the military, single-mindedly fulfilling his role as a soldier, he suddenly found himself confronted by a small child who thanked him for saving her village.  It was this, in combination with Valzeride's affirmation that it was his actions that saved that girl's hope for the future, that convinced him that even someone like him, someone who only has a talent for warfare, can give hope to and protect others.  He is a husband and father of thirteen children, five of them his own, eight of them adopted battlefield orphans.  He is also a Third Generation Masei.  Unlike many Fanatics of Light, he knows that he can't do everything on his own and he is quite willing to pass the baton to someone else when he can no longer continue.[/spoiler]
